senses.definition_en: someone who supports United States interventionism and imitates the culture of the United States

examples.english: […] he brags when he declares: "I feel more American than the president of the United States." ¶ Willie Santana is the perfect pitiyanqui, disguised as a Puerto Rican.
examples.ref: 1964, Cesáreo Rosa-Nieves, Mañana será la esperanza, page 78:
examples.text: […]se jacta en afirmar: —Yo me siento más norteamericano que el presidente de Estados Unidos. ¶ Willie Santana es el perfecto pitiyanqui, disfrazado de boricua.
examples.translation: […] he brags when he declares: "I feel more American than the president of the United States." ¶ Willie Santana is the perfect pitiyanqui, disguised as a Puerto Rican.

examples.english: With their obstructionism, what they do is perpetuate the colony, protect the interests of United States in Puerto Rico, and continue making Puerto Rico a property of the United States; these are the true pitiyanquis.
examples.ref: 2012, Dr. Guillermo González, De Cobitos, Jaibas y Lambe Ojos: Sobre la Personalidad Colonizada en Puerto Rico, →ISBN, page 102:
examples.text: Con su obstruccionismo lo que hacen es perpetuar la colonia, protegen los intereses de las compañías norteamericanas en Puerto Rico y continúan haciendo de Puerto Rico una posesión de los Estados Unidos; estos son los verdaderos pitiyanquis.
examples.translation: With their obstructionism, what they do is perpetuate the colony, protect the interests of United States in Puerto Rico, and continue making Puerto Rico a property of the United States; these are the true pitiyanquis.

glosses: someone who supports United States interventionism and imitates the culture of the United States
